purpose: Independent cohort and truly forward temporal replication; descriptive research only
preRegistration: Freeze before reading any Phase 15D forward or independent-cohort outcome labels

primaryModel.training: 15C sealed-test model fitted on pre-2025-01-06 labeled data; no Phase 15B Test or Phase 15D data used for fit

modelContract.featureRegistry: Exact ordered Phase 15C feature list; D0 EVENT-only subset
modelContract.forbidden: future/outcome/label and all direct or indirect volume, liquidity, trading-value and turnover features; total Trigger Score forbidden
modelContract.preprocessing: Saved 15C train-only numeric median, 1%-99% clipping, standard-deviation scaling and missing indicators; saved train-only categorical one-hot vocabulary with MISSING and UNKNOWN buckets
modelContract.families: Saved 15C alpha-10 Logistic and deterministic 120-round LightGBM; no fit, tuning or calibration update on forward holdout

sourceCohorts.selector: STATUS_CHANGED with currentStatus BELOW_ZONE; no dedicated Outcome selector; first audit events and feasibility

commonSourceFilters: Copy the audited 15B Monthly or Biweekly research request without changing other fields or thresholds

forwardEligibility.rule: featureAsOfDate + 60 market sessions must be <= cutoff; actual label availability must be true; exclude episodes with first event <= 2025-09-12

independentCohortEvaluation.frozenTransfer: Apply saved D0 models unchanged to eligible cohort rows
independentCohortEvaluation.withinCohortWalkForward: Same three 140-session pre-2025 Validation folds as 15C with episode isolation and strict label-availability purge; no hyperparameter changes
independentCohortEvaluation.nativeFinalTest: Single separately logged evaluation of source cohort 2025-01-06 onward after validation; never used for tuning
independentCohortEvaluation.smallSample: Report event/episode/ticker and positive/negative counts first; suppress ML interpretation when fewer than 40 eligible rows or only one class

metrics: Q1-Q5 count/rate/median return/median MFE/median MAE/return Q25/Q75
minimumReporting: direct and transitive liquidity feature count
noRetuneRule: Never change cohort, MA pair, event selector, feature list, model, seed, target, date boundary or reporting rule after looking at outcomes; the Phase 15C 0.666 is reference only
